message.content:
The left triangle has hypotenuse \(2\) and a \(60^\circ\) angle, so its vertical leg is

\[
2\sin 60^\circ=2\cdot \frac{\sqrt3}{2}=\sqrt3.
\]

This vertical leg is shared with the right triangle, which has a \(45^\circ\) angle, so it is a \(45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle. Thus its legs are both \(\sqrt3\), and the hypotenuse is

\[
x=\sqrt{(\sqrt3)^2+(\sqrt3)^2}=\sqrt6.
\]

The answer is \(\sqrt{6}\).
